description: Monthly observation ridgelines for the ten most recorded mammal species in Dataset/observations-794195.csv (top ten selected across all source dates). Observation dates from 2016–2025 are pooled, excluding incomplete 2026. Subspecies are combined using the first two scientific-name components, matching Lollipop.vg.json. Includes records without coordinates. All 12 months are filled for each species. Heights show monthly counts divided by that species total, on one shared percentage scale. Monotone curves connect monthly values; no kernel density estimation is applied. Rows follow full-source species rank. Southern hemisphere meteorological seasons are shown. Hover monthly cells for exact counts and shares; click a cell or species label to toggle highlighting. Counts measure recording activity, not animal abundance or nationwide sampling. Species colours match the ten-species palette in BumpChart.vg.json; species selection and observation counts are unchanged.
